projects.title: Resume Tailoring Pipeline – Asynchronous Automation Tool | Python
bullets: Architected an asynchronous Python pipeline orchestrating parallel LLM APIs (Claude, GPT-4o) with an automated arbitration stage.
Enforced strict schema validation and whitelist matching against local JSON datasets, ensuring 100% deterministic output compliance.
Implemented regex parsing and a local keyword frequency-ranking fallback to guarantee execution during network or API timeouts.
